name: Markdown to HTML
summary: Convert Markdown to HTML locally — headings, lists, tables, code fences, and more.
description: Paste Markdown and get HTML output in your browser. Supports headings, bold/italic, links, images, lists (including task lists), blockquotes, fenced code blocks, horizontal rules, and GFM-style tables. Optional wrap in an article element.

faqs.question: Is this full CommonMark?
faqs.answer: No. It covers common Markdown and GFM features (tables, strikethrough, task lists) for everyday conversion — not a complete spec implementation.

faqs.question: Is HTML in the source escaped?
faqs.answer: Yes. Raw angle brackets in text are escaped so pasted Markdown cannot inject tags unless you deliberately write Markdown that produces them (links, images).

faqs.question: Need a live preview instead?
faqs.answer: Use Markdown Preview to render GFM visually side-by-side.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Conversion runs entirely in your browser.
